videos.title: Starlink Gen 3 vs Starlink Mini: Power Draw, DC 12V-48V & Mobile Rigging
videos.script_narration: Choosing between the SpaceX Starlink Gen 3 standard dish and the portable Starlink Mini depends on your power budget and mounting application. I'm Gary Pearce from ADI Communications, with twenty-five years of hands-on trade craftsmanship. The Gen 3 terminal pulls seventy-five to one hundred watts and requires AC mains or a dedicated step-up converter. The Mini runs directly on twelve to forty-eight volt DC power, drawing under forty watts, ideal for mobile camper vans, marine craft, or remote site cabins. We design custom DC-to-DC fused harnesses with heavy-duty weather seals. Call me on 07860 244 274 for trade advice.

videos.title: Starlink Non-Drill Chimney Lashing Kits vs Galvanised Pennine Wall Brackets
videos.script_narration: Never drill directly into soft Victorian chimney brickwork to secure a high-drag satellite dish. I'm Gary Pearce from ADI Communications, with over twenty-five years of Yorkshire field experience. Under Eurocode 1 wind calculations, chimney drilling causes freeze-thaw spalling and masonry collapse. We install heavy-duty twin-wire galvanised chimney lashing kits fitted with steel corner mitre protectors, distributing clamping force evenly across the stack. For properties without chimneys, we fit heavy-gauge galvanised Pennine wall brackets into solid structural masonry using high-tensile sleeve anchors. To protect your roof structure, telephone Gary Pearce directly on 07860 244 274.

videos.script_narration: Freeview picture breakup can stem from several causes: 5G mobile mast interference, waterlogged coax cables, or corroded outdoor splitters. I'm Gary Pearce from ADI Communications, drawing on twenty-five years of hands-on trade craftsmanship. Old brown coaxial cable has air-spaced dielectric cores that draw in rainwater via capillary action, quietly shorting out UHF frequencies over time. We run complete spectrum diagnostic sweeps to pinpoint whether the fault is water ingress or cellular interference, restoring perfect television reception quickly. For expert aerial troubleshooting across Yorkshire, call Gary on 07860 244 274.
